payload.description:
# Agent copy-edit: scan, judge, and compare

## Intent

As a **copy-editing agent** (or a human using the same CLI), I want one scan of a draft against the publication's voice config plus an A/B compare tool, so I can find pertinent problems, rank my own rewrite candidates, and check that tweaks do not regress quality — then a human still chooses what lands.

This initiative **reimagines** the diagnose → steer → options → weighted-`verify` loop (`LIM-9d14e6`). The old loop shipped. The successor is agent-first, mixed-signal scan, and compare — not a single quality score and not a silent editor.

## Product shape

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  draft[Draft + style profile]
  scan[limatus scan]
  always[Always lane: profile heuristics]
  judge[Judge lane: configured OpenAI, Terra default]
  findings[Union of findings + optional rubric]
  agent[Agent records skip/rewrite/delete/keep]
  options[Generate 2-3 patch options]
  compare[limatus compare]
  human[Human chooses]
  apply[Apply to working copy]
  draft --> scan
  scan --> always
  scan --> judge
  always --> findings
  judge --> findings
  findings --> agent --> options --> compare --> human --> apply
  apply --> compare
```

- **Scan** — invoke on text + voice config → pertinent, steer-able suggestions. Always-lane runs without a network. Judge-lane runs when OpenAI is configured (default model: GPT-5.6 Terra). Stochastic judge output is accepted. Judge **adds** findings; it never drops always-lane hits.
- **Prioritize** — the **agent or human**, not a hidden filter inside scan. Decisions are explicit and recorded.
- **Compare** — rank 2–3 candidate texts, or original vs working copy for regression. Always-lane hard constraints (e.g. unsupported claims must not increase) can fail a candidate even if prose “sounds nicer.” All candidates stay visible; ranking does not hide losers.
- **Human** still chooses. No auto-publish. No detector scores.

## Guardrails

- Quality loop, not detector evasion.
- No single opaque `quality` score as a publish gate. No `should_accept_revision` as auto-apply.
- Other LLM providers (Bedrock, Anthropic, Google, etc.) are **out of scope** this stage. Config is OpenAI-only; model id is per-project (Terra default).
- Cost: Terra default for judge/compare, not Sol.

## Milestones (epics)

1. Unified scan surface
2. Voice-local always-lane signals
3. Configured OpenAI judge lane
4. Compare candidates and regression
5. Agent copy-edit loop
6. Gold-set canary (calibration)

## Supersedes

- Weighted advisory verifier (`LIM-877130`) as the agent-facing “is this better?” tool — replaced by **compare** (deltas + optional rubric + ranking).
- “Diagnose must be deterministic” as a product law — replaced by **lanes** (always vs configured judge).

Papyrus remains a caller via the Limatus SDK (`LIM-3ff8d0`). New behavior is specified and shipped in **Limatus**.
